_doc: Grandfathered violations of validator rules V-45..V-51 (added 2026-11-01), V-55 (added 2026-11-04), V-60 (added 2026-11-09) and V-65/V-67 (added 2026-11-20, SCHEMA v1.17). IDs listed here only WARN; any other violating row is an ERROR. Shrink this list as rows are fixed; never add IDs to it to make a new violation pass (that is a protocol violation, AGENTS.md section 1). Regenerating it requires an owner-approved PR.
amended: 2026-11-01: V-50/V-51 added under owner ruling 2026-11-01 (battery P1/P2); existing violators grandfathered for the integrator's cleanup pass. 2026-11-02: V-45 shrunk by 139 (synonym site_type fixes) and V-47 by 290 (ruled NAICS provenance proposals), per tasks/validator-debt-apply-2026-11-02/ (owner battery 2026-11-01 R1/R4). 2026-11-02: V-49 shrunk by 2 (ORG-001484, ORG-001488: 'automotive' -> automotive_unspecified, tasks/vocab-normalize-2026-11-02/). 2026-11-04: V-55 added (processes/materials vocabulary on sites+organizations; 2,885 legacy records grandfathered at adoption — the free-text cleanup is a separate campaign). 2026-11-09: V-60 (evidence must not cite a licensed publication, AGENTS.md §5) adopted with its 36 existing violators grandfathered; each is answered by a public-source row in tasks/licensed-source-cleanup-2026-11-09/. 2026-11-19: V-55 shrunk by 1 (ORG-001470 now passes; validate.py reported it as a stale entry). 2026-11-20: V-65 (no naked tier-A/B, SCHEMA v1.17 §4.13 floor rule) adopted with its 2,747 existing violators grandfathered (organizations 1,214; sites 1,324; ecosystem 78; programs 9; people 122 — live tier-A/B records with no supporting evidence row at their own strength; tombstone statuses merged/tombstoned out of scope); the census is a re-verification queue, worked down as lanes evidence the records. V-67 (no staging pointer in a published citation field, SCHEMA v1.17 §4.12.2) adopted with its 185 existing violators grandfathered (122 event_participation evidence_source_url, 61 code_assignments source_ref, 2 evidence source_ref); the participation repairs are a separate data pass. V-66 (archive-at-capture, §4.22) has no baseline: no evidence row above the EVD-400365 threshold exists at adoption. 2026-11-20: V-68 (SCHEMA §4.13 presence floor for tier C/U: every tier-C/U record has at least one evidence row; V-65 covers tier A/B) adopted under owner ruling 2026-11-20 with 858 records grandfathered (ecosystem 52, organizations 182, people 10, programs 1, sites 613); keys are <record_table>:<record_id>:<identity fingerprint>; tasks/evidence-presence-floor-2026-11-20/.
